RJ Mitte, 'Breaking Bad' Actor, Dies at 34

RJ Mitte, an actor known for his role as Walter White Jr. in the television series 'Breaking Bad,' has died at the age of 34. Mitte, who lived with cerebral palsy and advocated for disability representation, died in Brownsville, Texas. His representatives confirmed his death on Monday. The cause of death was not immediately revealed, and police were investigating. Colleagues, including 'Breaking Bad' co-stars Aaron Paul, Dean Norris, and Bryan Cranston, paid tribute to him.
